rationale: FX03 flags cost_currency=U_USD as not USD, but the raw SOI shows the flagged cost/fair-value fields in dollar-denominated investment columns. The cited Infrabuild row has cost 6,280,041 and fair value 6,438,573, and the same schedule rolls to a dollar-labeled Total Investments line. This supports U_USD as a USD unit token rather than a non-USD currency defect; the rule should not fire on this source.
